Sets the topic to subscribe to. The topic specified can be the literal topic
name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

A comma-separated list of options for the command. Set the conflation
interval and the fields that determine a unique message in the options.
For example, to set a conflation interval of 250 milliseconds for
messages that have the same value for /id, provide the following
option: conflation=250ms,conflation_key= [/id]. To set the conflation
interval to 1 minute for messages that are the same, as determined by a
combination of /customerId and /issueNumber, provide an option of:
conflation=1m, conflation_key=[/customerId,/issueNumber].
